title: Mail Operations Email Account Optional Lookup Permission Consistency

items.action: load and display SMTP account choices in the mail operations filter

database.reason: No persistence model changes are introduced.

migration.reason: Existing email account read permission is reused.

backend.reason: Existing email account read authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

audit.reason: No mutation or new auditable backend action is introduced.

menu.reason: Mail Operations navigation remains governed independently by its existing read permission.

route_guard.reason: This change guards an optional lookup and filter, not route access.

notes: Mail Operations may be readable without fair_crm.email_accounts.read. The SMTP account filter is optional metadata, so the page now skips listEmailAccounts and hides that filter unless email-account read permission is granted, avoiding an unauthorized optional lookup while preserving mail-operation visibility.
